selectedComponents.title: Litany Engine Ossuary
selectedComponents.label: Litany Engine Ossuary
selectedComponents.summary: The location behaves like a devotional machine built from arranged remains.
selectedComponents.tableText: Every chamber seems arranged to continue a prayer that no living voice remembers.
selectedComponents.narrative: Use this as the main premise when bone ornament, worship, and architecture should feel like one system.

selectedComponents.title: Bone-Dust Breath
selectedComponents.label: Bone-Dust Breath
selectedComponents.summary: The air carries a dry mineral taste of powdered bone.
selectedComponents.tableText: The room tastes dry and mineral, as if each breath scrapes through old bone dust.
selectedComponents.narrative: Use as a low-pressure read-aloud layer for ossuary rooms.

selectedComponents.title: Clicking Skull Seams
selectedComponents.label: Clicking Skull Seams
selectedComponents.summary: Tiny clicks move through the walls whenever the room goes quiet.
selectedComponents.tableText: Small clicks travel through the bonework, like teeth settling after speech.
selectedComponents.narrative: Use to make silence feel responsive.

selectedComponents.title: Prayer-Slip Mortar
selectedComponents.label: Prayer-Slip Mortar
selectedComponents.summary: The mortar is packed with folded prayer slips and pale hair.
selectedComponents.tableText: The mortar between the stones has been packed with hair, ash, and old prayer slips.
selectedComponents.narrative: Use as an immediate visible sign that points to the source theme.

selectedComponents.title: Reliquary Fragment Key
selectedComponents.label: Reliquary Fragment Key
selectedComponents.summary: A bone fragment acts as a key to sacred locks.
selectedComponents.tableText: A labeled finger bone rests in a small silver tube, warm only near locked reliquaries.
selectedComponents.mechanics: The fragment opens one reliquary lock or reveals one hidden chapel mechanism.
selectedComponents.narrative: Keep it small, useful, and morally uncomfortable.

rules.text: The fragment opens one reliquary lock or reveals one hidden chapel mechanism.

selectedComponents.title: Weight-Sermon Slab
selectedComponents.label: Weight-Sermon Slab
selectedComponents.summary: A pressure slab releases hanging bonework when crossed carelessly.
selectedComponents.tableText: A sermon text is carved into a floor slab polished by knees and footsteps.
selectedComponents.mechanics: A creature that crosses the slab without moving carefully triggers a fall of bonework; it must make a Dexterity saving throw or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked Prone.
selectedComponents.narrative: Telegraph with dustless edges, hanging cords, and a carved warning about kneeling.

rules.text: A creature that crosses the slab without moving carefully triggers a fall of bonework; it must make a Dexterity saving throw or take bludgeoning damage and be knocked Prone.

selectedComponents.title: Reliquary Tripwire
selectedComponents.label: Reliquary Tripwire
selectedComponents.summary: A thread of rosary beads pulls open a reliquary of sharp fragments.
selectedComponents.tableText: A strand of beads runs ankle-high between two reliquary niches.
selectedComponents.mechanics: A creature that breaks the bead-line scatters sharp relic fragments in a short line; the area becomes difficult terrain until cleared.
selectedComponents.narrative: This is a trap that feels devotional rather than mechanical.

rules.text: A creature that breaks the bead-line scatters sharp relic fragments in a short line; the area becomes difficult terrain until cleared.

selectedComponents.title: Miscounted Skull Row
selectedComponents.label: Miscounted Skull Row
selectedComponents.summary: A skull row reveals that one skull has been replaced recently.
selectedComponents.tableText: One skull in the row is cleaner than the others, and the dust line behind it does not match.
selectedComponents.mechanics: Investigation reveals the replacement is fresh and deliberately placed.
selectedComponents.narrative: Use to point toward a recent intruder, victim, or cult act.

rules.text: Investigation reveals the replacement is fresh and deliberately placed.

selectedComponents.title: Bone Chandelier Map
selectedComponents.label: Bone Chandelier Map
selectedComponents.summary: The chandelier’s bone pattern mirrors the room layout.
selectedComponents.tableText: The bone chandelier repeats the map below in miniature, including one room no door reaches.
selectedComponents.mechanics: Studying the pattern reveals a hidden chamber or alternate route.

rules.text: Studying the pattern reveals a hidden chamber or alternate route.

selectedComponents.title: Bonework Cover Lines
selectedComponents.label: Bonework Cover Lines
selectedComponents.summary: Bone ornaments create brittle cover and collapsing lines of sight.
selectedComponents.tableText: Skull shelves and femur screens divide the room into narrow devotional lanes.
selectedComponents.mechanics: Creatures can use bonework as half cover, but missed ranged attacks or area damage may collapse it into difficult terrain.
selectedComponents.narrative: Adds tactical texture to ossuary fights.

rules.text: Creatures can use bonework as half cover, but missed ranged attacks or area damage may collapse it into difficult terrain.

selectedComponents.title: Reliquary Alarm Choir
selectedComponents.label: Reliquary Alarm Choir
selectedComponents.summary: Opening a reliquary causes the room to answer in bone clicks.
selectedComponents.tableText: When the reliquary opens, every skull niche begins clicking like a dry choir.
selectedComponents.mechanics: After a reliquary is disturbed, stealth becomes harder and nearby enemies are alerted unless the sound is muffled.

rules.text: After a reliquary is disturbed, stealth becomes harder and nearby enemies are alerted unless the sound is muffled.
